system.description: Starting at 14th level, you learn to infuse a mass of chakra into your Battle Medic state. As part of entering your Battle Medic state, you can invoke this Domain ability, spending 1 Charge and 2 Byakugou Seals. When you do, you gain the Strength of 1000 enhancements for the duration of this state. If an effect doesn’t appear in the enhancement, then default to the original effects of the Battle Medic state.
